title: Kidney Bean Tacos with German Twist
description: A fusion of German and Mexican flavors, this dish combines the comfort of traditional German cuisine with the vibrant taste of Mexican tacos.

ingredients.name: relish
ingredients.notes: such as sauerkraut or pickled vegetables

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high.
Add diced onions and cook until translucent.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add kidney beans and taco seasoning; stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by spooning bean mixture onto tortillas.
Top with shredded cheese, sour cream, relish, and cilantro.
